title: Anthropic: Ποιες δουλειές απειλεί περισσότερο η τεχνητή νοημοσύνη | Euronews
summary: Anthropic Economic Index measures the real-world impact of large language models (LLMs) like Anthropic's AI, Claude, across various professions. The index, based on early evidence, shows that while LLMs have significant potential in many fields, their current impact is most notable in roles requiring high levels of expertise, such as biology, healthcare, and law. The index also highlights the importance of human involvement in certain tasks, even with advanced AI assistance.
sentiment_reason: The sentiment is rated as 2 (negative) due to the acknowledgment of the current limited impact of LLMs in many professions, despite their potential. However, this is balanced by the recognition of their significant impact in specialized fields.
